entries.source: It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning, only 3 times bigger than a normal wolf. It looks hungry. You look tasty!
entries.target: 这是一只眼中满是狡黠的大狼，也就比普通狼大3倍而已。它看起来很饿，而你——看起来很美味！

entries.source: This portal will bring you back to the Tutorial Lobby.
entries.target: 这道传送门将把你带回教程大厅。

entries.source: Enter the portal back to the lobby?
entries.target: 你要进入传送门返回大厅吗？

entries.source: #VIOLET#You enter the swirling portal and in the blink of an eye you are back in the lobby.
entries.target: #VIOLET#你进入了传送漩涡，一眨眼功夫你回到了大厅。

entries.source: Contains a snippet of ToME wisdom.
entries.target: 包含了 ToME 智慧的残片。

entries.source: Causes the player's brain to jettison all recently-acquired knowledge.
entries.target: 可以净化玩家的大脑，使玩家遗忘所有最近所学的技能。

entries.source: #VIOLET#The sound of an ancient door grinding open echoes down the tunnel!
entries.target: #VIOLET#推开古老大门产生的吱呀声音回荡在通道里！

entries.source: #VIOLET#You have learned the talent Mana Gale.
#VIOLET#You have learned the talent Telekinetic Punt.
#VIOLET#You must achieve Enlightenment before you can pass. Seek ye to the west to discover the ancient art of Shoving Stuff.
entries.target: #VIOLET#你必须先达到“启蒙”境界才能通过。前往西方，探寻古老的“推物之术”。

entries.source: A pitchfork-wielding human with a welcoming smile.
entries.target: 一名手持草叉、面带友善微笑的人类。

entries.source:
Green-skinned and ugly, this massive humanoid glares at you, clenching wart-covered green fists.
He looks hurt.
entries.target:
绿皮丑陋，这只巨大的人形生物正盯着你，握紧了满是肉瘤的绿色拳头。
他看起来受伤了。

entries.source: It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning, only 3 times bigger than a normal wolf. It looks hungry. You look tasty!
entries.target: 这是一只眼中满是狡黠的大狼，也就比普通狼大3倍而已。它看起来很饿，而你——看起来很美味！

entries.source: An elf that looks as though he spends a good amount of his time wiggling his fingers and chanting.
entries.target: 这名精灵看起来把大量时间花在摆动手指和吟唱上。
一只巨大的蛛形纲生物。
一只巨大的、吱吱叫的蛛形生物。
